facts.label: Workflow
facts.value: The official FAQ identifies Devin Desktop as the new name for Windsurf and says the standard update preserves existing plan and pricing, including legacy Windsurf Enterprise. This does not verify the migration or entitlement of a particular account.

prices.name: Free
prices.billing: Published public plan price; the page displays USD 0/month.
prices.allowance: Light agent quota, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits and Tab completions.

prices.name: Pro

prices.allowance: Increased quotas and full model availability; exact included usage is not quantified here.

prices.name: Legacy Windsurf account entitlement

sections.heading: Product name and transition
paragraphs: The current official FAQ calls Devin Desktop the new name for Windsurf and says the standard over-the-air update preserves the IDE, extensions, workflows, settings, in-progress work, plans and pricing, including legacy Windsurf Enterprise. This record has not tested an individual account transition.

sections.heading: Keep price and account scope separate
paragraphs: The official plan page lists Free at USD 0/month, Pro at USD 20/month, Max at USD 200/month and Teams at USD 80/month plus USD 40/month per full developer seat. Paid-plan allowances refresh daily and weekly, extra usage can be purchased at API pricing, and actual cost varies by model and task. These public amounts do not establish a specific legacy account's entitlement, regional checkout total or actual spend.

faqs.question: Is Devin Desktop the new name for Windsurf?
faqs.answer: Yes. The official FAQ describes Devin Desktop as the new name for Windsurf and says the full IDE remains accessible.

faqs.question: What does the vendor say carries over during the standard update?
faqs.answer: The FAQ says plans, pricing, extensions, settings and in-progress work carry over with the standard over-the-air update, and that current plan pricing stays the same, including legacy Windsurf Enterprise. Confirm the applicable path for the specific account.

faqs.question: What public monthly prices does Devin list for the Windsurf continuation?
faqs.answer: The current plan page lists Free at USD 0/month, Pro at USD 20/month, Max at USD 200/month and Teams at USD 80/month plus USD 40/month per full developer seat. Paid-plan included usage refreshes daily and weekly; extra usage is available at API pricing. These are public plan amounts, not an account-specific legacy quote or total usage estimate.

verdict: Treat Devin Desktop as the documented continuation of Windsurf; use current public plan prices for general comparison, and verify any legacy account quote and usage terms before acting.
bestFor: Existing Windsurf users assessing the documented transition or current editor workflow
notFor: Buyers treating historical Windsurf prices as a current quote
migration: Record the current account and editor settings, confirm the official update applies, and rehearse the workflow before changing a production setup.
gaps: No account-specific transition or legacy entitlement was tested; public base plan prices do not establish the exact account quote, regional checkout taxes or actual usage cost.
